meta.name: Send weekly multi-platform review reports from Apify to Gmail

name: Actor 04B — Review Scraper → Weekly Client Reputation Report Email

parameters.content:
## Actor 04B — Review Scraper → Weekly Client Reputation Report Email

### How it works

This workflow runs every Friday morning to launch an Apify review-scraping actor, retrieve the resulting weekly review dataset, and organize the reviews by business. It then merges the generated business summaries, builds an HTML reputation report, and sends it by Gmail to the client or internal recipients.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger for the desired weekly send time and timezone.
- Add the Apify API token and verify the actor endpoint and dataset-fetching URL are correct.
- Configure the scraping actor input, including the businesses, review sources, date range, and any location filters required for the report.
- Set up Gmail credentials in n8n and configure the recipient, subject line, and sender options for the weekly report email.
- Review the custom code nodes to ensure the aggregation fields match the review data returned by Apify.

### Customization

Adjust the aggregation code to change how ratings, review counts, sentiment notes, or per-business highlights are summarized, and update the HTML builder to match the client’s branding or preferred report format.

## Schedule and start scrape

Starts the workflow on the weekly Friday schedule and sends a POST request to Apify to run the review-scraping actor.

## Fetch and aggregate reviews

Retrieves the newly scraped review dataset from Apify and uses custom code to group or summarize the reviews by business.

## Build and email report

Combines all business summaries, generates the final HTML report, and sends the weekly reputation report through Gmail.
